records.source: Plant these in the fall. Takes 13 days to mature.
records.translation: 秋季播種。需要 13 天成熟。

records.source: Read this to gain some experience in all skills.
records.translation: 閱讀後可獲得所有技能的少量經驗。

records.source: A rare mushroom found deep in caves.
records.translation: 在洞穴深處發現的稀有蘑菇。

records.source: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.
records.translation: 可以放進史萊姆孵化器孵化。

records.source: Plant these in any season. Water every day to produce a Qi Fruit. Takes 4 days to mature.
records.translation: 任何季節皆可播種。每天澆水即可長出齊果，需要 4 天成熟。

records.source: Mr. Qi has challenged you to ship 500 of these strange melons.
records.translation: 齊先生向你發起挑戰，要你出貨 500 顆這種奇怪的瓜。

records.source: A special currency honored by Mr. Qi.
records.translation: 齊先生認可的特殊貨幣。

records.source: Just a dash will elevate any dish to extraordinary heights. Automatically applied when cooking.
records.translation: 只要撒上一點，就能讓任何料理變得非比尋常。烹飪時會自動使用。

records.source: Boosts the quality of fish that you catch.
Improves soil quality, increasing your chance to grow quality crops. Mix into tilled soil.
records.translation: 改善土壤品質，提高種出優質作物的機率。拌入翻耕過的土壤。

records.source: This soil has a good chance of staying watered overnight. Mix into tilled soil.
records.translation: 這種土壤有很高機率整夜保持溼潤。拌入翻耕過的土壤。

records.source: Waters the 8 adjacent tiles every morning.
records.translation: 每天早上為相鄰的 8 格澆水。

records.source: A clear crystal commonly found in caves and mines.
records.translation: 常見於洞穴和礦坑的透明晶體。

records.source: Known by the Zuzu City Safety Commission to cause irreversible bodily harm.
records.translation: 祖祖市安全委員會證實，它會對人體造成不可逆的傷害。

records.source: A carp that spent one too many years in toxic sludge.
records.translation: 一條在有毒汙泥裡泡了太多年的鯉魚。

records.source: It's glowing with dangerous energy... Can be smelted into bars.
records.translation: 散發著危險能量的光芒……可以熔煉成錠。

records.source: A crisp and refreshing root vegetable with hints of pepper when eaten raw.
records.translation: 爽脆清新的根莖蔬菜，生吃時帶有淡淡的胡椒辛香。

records.source: Plant these in the summer. Takes 6 days to mature.
records.translation: 夏季播種。需要 6 天成熟。

records.source: A freshwater trout with colorful markings.
records.translation: 一種帶有彩色斑紋的淡水鱒魚。

records.source: Activate to greatly increase the chance for rain tomorrow. Consumed on use.
records.translation: 啟用後大幅提高明天下雨的機率。使用後消耗。

records.source: It's said to be the Junimos' favorite food.
records.translation: 據說是祝尼魔最喜愛的食物。

records.source: A heavy black disc studded with peculiar red stones. When you hold it, you're overwhelmed with a feeling of dread.
records.translation: 一塊鑲嵌奇特紅石的沉重黑色圓盤。握在手中時，強烈的恐懼感會席捲全身。

records.source: Sow in fall. Takes all season to grow.
records.translation: 秋季播種。需要整個季節才能長成。

records.source: Often used in salads and coleslaws. The color can range from purple to blue to green-yellow depending on soil conditions.
records.translation: 常用於沙拉和涼拌甘藍。依土壤條件不同，顏色可從紫色、藍色到黃綠色不等。

records.source: Plant these in the summer. Takes 9 days to mature.
records.translation: 夏季播種。需要 9 天成熟。

records.source: Long ago these were kept as pets.
records.translation: 很久以前，人們曾把牠們當寵物養。

records.source: A spotted mushroom sometimes found in caves.
records.translation: 偶爾能在洞穴裡找到的斑點蘑菇。

records.source: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.
records.translation: 可以放進史萊姆孵化器孵化。

records.source: A popular fish with a nice red color.
records.translation: 一種廣受歡迎、色澤鮮紅的魚。

records.source: A more pure form of quartz.
The stalks are extremely tart, but make a great dessert when sweetened.
records.translation: 莖部酸味極強，但加糖後能做成美味甜點。

records.source: Plant these in the spring. Takes 13 days to mature.
records.translation: 春季播種。需要 13 天成熟。
